summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing complete. Backend: 30/30 tests in test_iteration3.py pass (24 originally + fixed 6 review tests after allowing finished events to be viewed). Verified multi-currency checkout (INR base, USD/EUR/GBP/AED/SGD conversion with charge_subtotal/discount/tax/total + fx_rate + INR equivalent line), Stripe hosted checkout creation (session_id + real checkout.stripe.com URL), /api/payments/status polling returns non-paid until Stripe confirms and does NOT mark order paid, Stripe webhook rejects invalid signature (400), cross-user /payments/verify 404, unauthenticated /uploads 401, PNG upload + retrieval (image bytes + long cache header set by backend, though ingress overrides), non-image extension and >5MB uploads rejected with 400, reviews endpoints (attendee-only, once-per-user, average updates, top-rated sort, /me/reviewable), partner payouts (own only, 15% fee math correct), admin payouts listing, generate_payouts idempotent (no duplicate rows), mark paid writes audit + notifies partner + 2nd attempt returns friendly 400, partner2 can't see partner1 payouts, non-admin gets 403, admin per-currency price_overrides charge exactly the override amount instead of converted (USD 19 verified). Frontend: currency-picker (navbar SELECT) switches prices across events/passes/membership without reload (₹499 → $5.99 with 2 decimals, INR no decimals). Login works with data-testid selectors. Checkout page shows pay-stripe-btn when currency is USD, pay-success-btn/pay-failure-btn when INR. Clicking pay-stripe-btn navigates to real checkout.stripe.com sandbox page with amount US$16.23. Partner /partner Revenue & payouts tab renders payout rows with gross/fee/net/status/reference. Admin /admin Payouts tab shows all payouts with filters, 'Run settlement now' button (data-testid=generate-payouts) is present and idempotent. Reviews section renders reviews-average on finished events. One critical backend bug found and fixed by the testing agent (see rca).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1901 lines — split into routers (auth, payments, events, uploads, reviews, payouts, admin) before iter 4.

GET /api/events/{id} only permitted status=='published' for non-owner viewers, blocking any UI flow (reviews, ratings) for status=='completed' events. Fixed to accept both 'published' and 'completed' — this was the sole blocker for the entire review UI.

generate_payouts groups by event_id which is correct, but relies on a partial index on payouts.event_id being unique in practice; no explicit unique index. Consider `db.payouts.create_index('event_id', unique=True)` to enforce idempotency at the storage layer.

stripe_status polls the gateway synchronously on every /api/payments/status call — for high-traffic success pages consider caching last known status for a few seconds to avoid rate-limiting the shared platform Stripe key.

Stripe webhook route is `@app.post('/api/webhook/stripe')` (not on api router) — consistent with iter 2's razorpay webhook. Both correctly bypass CORS since they are server-to-server, but flag: signature verification is delegated to emergentintegrations.handle_webhook which raises a generic Exception that is caught and re-raised as 400 (verified in TestStripe.test_webhook_invalid_signature_rejected).

rca of the issue: GET /api/events/{event_id} rejected any status other than 'published' with 403 for non-owner viewers, so the moment /api/admin/payouts/generate flipped a finished event from status=published to status=completed, that event became invisible on the public detail page (renders 'Event unavailable — awaiting approval'). This broke the entire reviews UX chain: (1) Dashboard /me/reviewable did return the completed events, but the CTA link /events/{id} showed 'unavailable', (2) even attendees who tried to open the event directly to leave a rating were blocked, (3) the reviews-average could not surface on the detail page for events that closed 48h+ ago. Reproduction: seed_past_events.py runs, then generate_payouts() sets ev.status='completed' at line 1706 of server.py, then attendee visits /events/{id} → 403. Fix: line 596 now accepts status in ('published','completed'); admin/partner override remains unchanged. Verified live by loading the Supper Club detail page as ananya.kapoor after fix — reviews-average shows 4.5 (4).
